# CLI commands

> Generated by `scripts/docs-generate.ts` from the command sources under `packages/cli/src/commands/` and `packages/cli/src/lib/exit.ts`. Do not edit this file. Run `pnpm docs:generate` to update it.

11 commands. Every command answers `--help` with its usage and flags. The behavior of each command, its JSON output and the coordinate grammar are on [the reference page](../reference.md).

```text
saasaloy <command> [options]
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `init` | scaffold a new Saasaloy project (base: Astro landing + ui + config) |
| `add` | apply a module into the current project (resolves dependsOn) |
| `env` | fill in the environment variables the installed modules declare (--check gates a deploy) |
| `testing` | print the project's testing mode, or set it to off, tests-after or tdd |
| `outdated` | report the base template and each installed module, current vs latest (--check gates CI) |
| `update` | move the base template and modules to this CLI's release, merging your edits three ways |
| `remove` | take a module out of the project, keeping the files you edited (--abort undoes it) |
| `list` | list the modules a registry offers, marking the ones installed here |
| `new` | scaffold a new module in a registry repo (descriptor + files/ + skill stub) |
| `doctor` | validate local module descriptors, or a project's saasaloy.json against its manifest |
| `skill` | print a base skill bundled with this CLI, or list them (the runbook that matches this version) |

## Exit codes

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | `EXIT_OK` | the command did what it was asked, or you answered no to a confirmation |
| `1` | `EXIT_FAILURE` | something failed, or you cancelled: a fetch died, a write threw, Ctrl-C |
| `2` | `EXIT_REFUSED` | saasaloy refused by design: an unknown flag or command, a module conflict, an unmet `requiresOneOf`, an invalid state file, a `doctor` or `env --check` finding, or a prompt with no terminal to answer it in |
| `3` | `EXIT_WORK_PENDING` | `saasaloy update` only: the run applied what it could and left work pending, such as files waiting on a merge or update notes not yet marked done |

## `saasaloy init`

```text
saasaloy init [<name>] [--force] [--yes | --no-install] [--no-git] [--testing=<off|tests-after|tdd>] [--theme=<neutral|cobalt|ember|moss>]
```

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--force` | scaffold into a directory that is not empty |
| `-y, --yes` | run pnpm install with no prompt, and take the neutral theme when --theme is absent |
| `--no-install` | never run pnpm install, and never ask |
| `--no-git` | do not run git init or make the first commit |
| `--testing=<mode>` | the testing mode: off (default), tests-after or tdd; asked on a terminal when absent |
| `--theme=<name>` | the Saasaloy UI theme brand.css takes: neutral (default), cobalt, ember or moss; asked on a terminal when absent |
| `-h, --help` | show this help |

## `saasaloy add`

```text
saasaloy add [<module>...|<owner/repo[@ref]/module>...|<owner/repo>] [--with <module>]... [--dry-run [--json]] [--diff] [--yes] [--force] | saasaloy add --abort
```

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show the plan and write nothing |
| `--diff` | show a per-file diff and write nothing |
| `-y, --yes` | skip the confirmation prompt |
| `--force` | write even over uncommitted changes, overwrite edited generated files, and write the deleted files of a named module again |
| `--with <module>` | answer a `requiresOneOf` choice, e.g. `--with api-keys-user` (repeatable) |
| `--json` | with --dry-run, print the plan as one JSON document on stdout |
| `--abort` | put back the files the last add, remove, update or testing run changed |
| `-h, --help` | show this help |

## `saasaloy env`

```text
saasaloy env [--check [--json]] [--from-file <path>]... [--set KEY=VALUE]...
```

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--check` | report missing variables and exit non-zero, without prompting |
| `--json` | with --check, print the report as one JSON document on stdout |
| `--from-file <path>` | write the KEY=VALUE lines of a dotenv file, with no prompt (repeatable) |
| `--set KEY=VALUE` | write one value, with no prompt (repeatable); it stays in your shell history, so prefer --from-file for a secret |
| `-h, --help` | show this help |

## `saasaloy outdated`

```text
saasaloy outdated [--check] [--json]
```

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--check` | exit non-zero when the base template or any module has moved, or an update note is pending (for CI) |
| `--json` | print the rows as one JSON document on stdout |
| `-h, --help` | show this help |

## `saasaloy update`

```text
saasaloy update [--restore <path>]... [--merge <path>]... [--done <id>]... [--dry-run] [--diff] [--force] [--yes] | saasaloy update --abort
```

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--abort` | put back the files the last add, remove, update or testing run changed |
| `--diff` | show a per-file diff and write nothing |
| `--done <id>` | record an update note whose work is finished, so the report stops listing it (repeatable) |
| `--dry-run` | show the report and write nothing |
| `--force` | apply even with uncommitted changes in the working tree, and overwrite edited generated files |
| `--merge <path>` | merge a file written once with its upstream change, three ways (repeatable) |
| `--restore <path>` | write a tracked file the project deleted again, from the current upstream (repeatable) |
| `-y, --yes` | skip the confirmation prompt |
| `-h, --help` | show this help |

## `saasaloy remove`

```text

```

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|

| `--diff` | show what each deletion removes, and delete nothing |
| `-y, --yes` | skip the confirmation prompt |
| `--force` | delete and merge even over uncommitted changes, and overwrite edited generated files |
| `--abort` | put back the files the last add, remove, update or testing run changed |
| `-h, --help` | show this help |

## `saasaloy list`

```text
saasaloy list [<owner/repo[@ref]>|@<ref>] [--installed] [--available] [--json]
```

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--installed` | list only the modules this project has installed |
| `--available` | list only the modules this project has not installed |
| `--json` | print one JSON document with each module's descriptor fields on stdout |
| `-h, --help` | show this help |
